title: Q-GAP-front-door-qualify: Run the system test at the public front door before BUILD-1 builds a page
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::systemTest
**Status:** done
**Evidence:** systemTest in site/worker.js refuses one-offs with HTTP 422 not_a_fit; site/site.test.mjs passes (VISION.md known drift: none open)

Gap in component `front-door`: /api/idea builds a one-page site from any idea, which contradicts docs/doctrine/VISION.md. The interview must ask the four system-test questions (loop, measure, upkeep, run cost) and answer a non-system with a plain not-a-fit and what to use instead, as seed/bootstrap/bootstrap.py stage qualify already does. Source: docs/doctrine/VISION.md (VISION-1).
